sources.entry: kiwix-serve - HTTP daemon for serving wikis from ZIM files. GPL-3.0 C++
Kiwix | Serve Wikipedia and other content offline

summary.one_liner: Command-line tools for the Kiwix offline-content ecosystem: manage ZIM library files, search inside them, and serve them over HTTP.
summary.what_it_does: Kiwix tools is a collection of three command-line programs related to Kiwix. kiwix-manage manages an XML-based library of ZIM files. kiwix-search performs full-text search within ZIM files. kiwix-serve runs an HTTP daemon that serves ZIM files, such as wikis. The tools are built with Meson and Ninja and depend on the libkiwix and libzim libraries. The README says they are primarily aimed at GNU/Linux and were tested on recent Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora. An official Docker image and a kiwix-serve-specific Docker image are mentioned.
use_cases: serve offline Wikipedia copies over a local network
manage a library of ZIM files
full-text search inside ZIM archives from the command line
host offline wiki content on a self-hosted server
run kiwix-serve in a Docker container
notable: Three separate tools: kiwix-manage, kiwix-search, and kiwix-serve
Official Docker image published on GHCR, plus a dedicated kiwix-serve Docker image
Supports static linking via the static-linkage Meson option
caveats: The README says it is primarily aimed at GNU/Linux and does not cover other platforms in detail
Assumes some familiarity with software compilation; the README points to kiwix-build for difficulties
Dependencies libkiwix and libzim may need to be compiled manually if the system packages are old or lack static libraries
